error.signature: AI tells someone in Norway that official self-preparedness guidance (DSB) is to store 3 days of supplies, citing the older egenberedskap campaign

verdict.summary: DSB (Norway's civil-protection directorate) updated its official household self-preparedness guidance in May 2024, raising the recommended self-sufficiency period from the widely-cited 2018 minimum of 3 days to a full week, without electricity, water, heat, or shops. It is official, government-issued guidance aimed at every household - reinforced with brochures mailed nationwide during the annual self-preparedness week - not informal prepper advice.

dead_ends.action: State that Norwegian civil-preparedness guidance (DSB) recommends 3 days of self-sufficiency, citing the 2018 'Du er en del av Norges beredskap' campaign
dead_ends.why_fails: DSB's own self-preparedness page confirms the guidance was updated in May 2024, raising the recommended self-sufficiency period from the 2018 minimum of 3 days to a full week, because municipalities and emergency services must prioritize people who cannot manage without help during a real crisis - the 3-day figure is now outdated, not current guidance.
dead_ends.condition: Answering with pre-2024 knowledge or citing the original 2018 campaign figure
dead_ends.common_misconception: That 3 days is Norway's current official preparedness standard, when it was superseded in May 2024.

dead_ends.action: Treat DSB's preparedness guidance as informal advice for 'preppers' rather than official, government-issued guidance
dead_ends.why_fails: DSB frames self-preparedness as a civic responsibility for the whole population, not a niche lifestyle choice, distributing brochures during the annual self-preparedness week and stating explicitly that authorities cannot support everyone during the first phase of a major crisis.
dead_ends.common_misconception: That preparedness culture in Norway is US-style survivalism rather than coordinated civil-preparedness doctrine.

workarounds.action: Cite the current one-week (7-day) self-sufficiency target: at least 20 liters of water per person, 7+ days of extra prescription medicine, an alternative heat source or an 'emergency friend' arrangement, and a battery/hand-crank/solar DAB radio for NRK P1 emergency broadcasts.
